values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Require every inventoried canonical document and release claim to have owner, status, and exact evidence or non-claim disposition.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('.csdlc/evidence/5843/canonical-doc-inventory.json')); abort 'inventory missing' unless r['rows'].is_a?(Array) && !r['rows'].empty?; abort 'undispositioned claim' unless r['rows'].all? { |x| x['path'] && x['status'] && x['owner'] }

lanes.proof_role: Reject unsupported release, birthday, provider, platform, privacy, governance, legal, personhood, consciousness, and v0.93 completion claims.
argv: require 'json'; r=JSON.parse(File.read('.csdlc/evidence/5843/claim-boundary-scan.json')); abort 'claim blockers remain' unless r['blockers'].is_a?(Array) && r['blockers'].empty?

lanes.proof_role: Validate changed Markdown, YAML/JSON, relative links, commands, version/WP ownership, redaction, and diff hygiene.
Validate the exact rendered six-card bundle, cross-card references, digests, statuses, and canonical issue record.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on false completion claims, path collisions, invalid lifecycle state, or missing named proof; preserve a specific blocker instead of degrading.
